result.stdout:
Usage: [arguments...] [options...] [-h|--help] [--version]

Recursively cleans bin/obj and optionally node_modules directories.

Arguments:
  [0] <string?>    Optional directory to start the clean. Defaults to current directory.

Options:
  --dry-run    List directories but don't actually delete them.
  --node       Opt-in to clean node_modules directories.
  --dotted     Opt-in to clean inside hidden directories.
